newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Moody's confirms Taiwan's ICBC bank ratings.
newsitem.headline: Moody's confirms Taiwan's ICBC bank ratings.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Monday it confirmed the long-term deposit, Prime-1 short-term and financial strength ratings of Taiwan's International Commercial Bank of China (ICBC).
"The confirmation is based on ICBC's good financial fundamentals, high liquidity, and the expectation that CAB (The Chinese American Bank) will be sold for a gain," it said in a statement.
"Moody's ratings also reflect ICBC's government ownership and strong regulatory support," it said.

The rating agency said sanctions imposed on the bank by the United States Federal Reserve for alleged inaccurate disclosure of its ownership at the time of its 1984 purchase of CAB would have no material impact on the creditworthiness of ICBC.
